title: SS27 Boys' Trending Trims Report
summary: Boys' trims: side stripes and piping, rubberised badges, sailor tape, bar-tacked utility pockets and reflective details.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Sport influence was presented "through a more refined, creative lens"; denim felt "stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Sailor collars, navy blues and nautical details appeared throughout Playtime Paris<sup>[1]</sup>
- Junior Style saw a "growing whimsical trend", layered styling and character-driven accessories; Tinycottons showed a "wonderfully chic bellboy character"<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Trims table
sections.body:
| Trim | Application | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Side stripes and piping | Track sets, shorts | Rising |
| Rubberised badges | Tees, caps | Rising |
| Sailor collar tape | Shirts | Rising |
| Utility pockets | Shorts, overalls | Core |
| Character appliqué | Tees | Core |

design_implications:
- Avoid sharp metal hardware; prefer rubber and fabric trims.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Trims refresh core tees and shorts.

sources.title: Playtime Paris SS27: where fashion met the spirit of a summer music festival
